headline: Banked reset verified as available
sourceTimezone: Not provided; X timestamp recorded in UTC
originalTimeText: We are loading a banked reset
scope: A usable banked reset has been verified in the account's reset interface. Tibo announced loading for Plus, Pro, and Business users; availability across all accounts has not been verified.

announcement.text: And one more thing. We are loading a banked reset into all accounts of our Plus, Pro and Business users. Let's go!
announcement.translation: 还有一件事。我们正在向所有 Plus、Pro 和 Business 用户的账户装载一次储备重置。开始吧！

note: The account's reset interface now shows an available banked reset, verified by the site owner. This observation is separate from Tibo's earlier public loading announcement.
